message.content:
The numbers 2, 6, 12, 20, 30,… are the “pronic” (or oblong) numbers: each term is the product of two consecutive integers.  In fact if you label them so that   
 a₁=2, a₂=6, a₃=12…  
then    
 aₙ = n·(n+1).  

Check:  
n=1 → 1·2 =2  
n=2 → 2·3 =6  
n=3 → 3·4 =12  
n=4 → 4·5 =20  
n=5 → 5·6 =30  

Equivalently aₙ = n² + n.
